This later position is exactly drawn by independent finite non-loss certificates for both sides. Black can choose Be6 for immediate stalemate. White’s certificate checks all twenty Black replies, reaching actual stalemate or actual mate; the Rc7/Bxg7+/Rxg7 source route is checked inside that certificate without claiming the intermediate Rc7 position’s exact outcome.
